༄༅// rdo rje gur mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor dbyangs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ye shes lnga mdangs rab 'bar rin chen lnga'i rang bzhin// grong khyer lnga bdag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo lnga ldan du// dug lnga ldan pa gnas gyur ye shes lnga bdag nyid// nges par smin mdzad bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gros skyongs// bde gshegs yon tan mtha' klas mkha' 'gro lnga yi rigs// bsdus pa bde chen snying po 'dzin pa ga la bar// lhas bskos gdul bya smin byed dbang bskur cho ga yi// mtshams sbyor dbyangs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di// gsang chen thabs rgyud zab mo'i dka' gnas gcong rong khar// blo gros som nyi'i lcug phran gzhon nur 'khyud pa rnams// rang gzhan yid ches bde ba'i grong khyer phyin 'dod pas// dpyad gsum gyis brling rin chen zom stegs 'dir spyon cig /'dir rdo rje gur mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du gdul bya smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor cho ga shar pas mdzad pa'i mchod phreng*/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i gsal byed/ paṇa chen thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i zur 'debs rnams kyi steng nas cho ga rnam par dag par bya ba nyid do// gnyis pa ni dbang bskur don du gnyer ba'i slob ma gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas gral rim bzhin 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdom bgyi snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa yang theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/

de la thog mar bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// de yi sdug bsngal rtag tu me mtshon rgya tsha la sogs reg bskyed bzhin// zhes gsungs te/ de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za ba dang gsod pa dang bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pa dang mi 'dod pa thog tu bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha rnams la 'chi 'pho dang gong ma nas 'og mar ltung ba dang*/ mthar ngan song du skye bar shes pas na dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams yod par bshad/ 'o na sdug bsngal de dag las rang nyid gcig pu thar ba'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing gzhan don gyi phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung*/ mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin na/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das shing*/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu'i don du ma yin te/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/

mtha' med pa'i sems can re re nas kyang bdag gi pha ma byas shing*/ pha ma byas res kyi gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pa la/ 'di rnams 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba thob pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis ni ldong*/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang ni bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu bas ni ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas rdeg 'chos shing*/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'grem pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral/ bde ba la dgod dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag bas lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa la'ang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/ bdag gis ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med las mi thob pas rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdom bgyi zhing lam la'ang ci nus kyis 'bad pa bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed 'tshal/ bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'grub pa yin/ 'di gzhan du nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed du gzhug pa'i dod yin pas ma chad par bya'o// de lta bu'i blo can la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par theg pa che chung gi dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/

'dir mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste// chen po 'di dag dang ldan pas// theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa ltar theg pa chung ngu las khyad chos bdun gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa theg pa chen po yin/ de la'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa ltar theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la rgyud sde gsum dang*/ bzhi dang*/ lnga dang drug tu 'dod pa la sogs pa mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa las/ 'dir 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor gong ma de ltag la// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso bor ston pa bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang ting nge 'dzin mnyam par ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ nang ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po rnam pa bzhi las/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ de'ang byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos/ rnal 'byor thabs kyis ma yin zhing*// rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas// dges rdor 'di ni phyogs gcig min// zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs rgya che ba gtso bor ston pa thabs kyi rgyud/

shes rab zab pa gtso bor ston pa shes rab kyi rgyud/ gnyis ka cha mnyam du ston pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyud de gsum las/ 'dir thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa'i bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mi thub zla ba zhes bya ba skye ba bdun pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas brten nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen pa de nyid kyis bkral ba'i rdo rje gur mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bsgrub par bgyi/ de la spyir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gang zag dbang po yang rab rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti lta bu rnams ni dbang rjes de ma thag par grol bar bshad de/ 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba las/ dngos grub thams cad ni dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba las 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kyang*/ des na gang zag dbang po rab// dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs// zhes so// gang zag mchog ma yin pas kyang dbang nyid rtag tu goms par byas na/ lam gzhan ma bsgoms kyang skye ba bdun na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs te/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na// skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur// de yis skye ba bdun na ni// ma bsgoms par yang dngos grub thob// ces so// dbang thob nas rtsa ba'i ltung bas ma gos na lam la 'bad pa cher ma nus kyang skye ba bcu drug nas dngos grub 'grub par gsungs te/ slob dpon pad+ma bas dam tshig lnga pa las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na// skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub// ces so// dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i gang zag rnams la grol byed kyi lam ston pa'i snod rung du byed pa'i thabs kyang dbang nyid yin te/

phyag chen thig le las/ dang por re zhig slob ma la// dbang rnams lan gcig bskur ba yis// de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi// nges par snod du gyur pa'o// zhes so// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i snying po ni smin grol gnyis yin zhing*/ grol byed kyi lam sgom pa'i sngon du'ang smin byed kyi dbang nyid nges par 'gro dgos te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces so// grol byed kyi lam yang dbang dus su thob pa'i rgyun de goms par byed pa'i thabs te/ de phyir dbang bskur thob pa ste// bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa la// sgom pa zhes su btags pa yin// zhes so// des na dbang bskur ba rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa bar grub pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang bskur bas tshe rabs mang po'i sdig pa 'dag pa ni 'og tu spro ba bskyed pa'i skabs sogs su rgya cher 'byung ba dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub rig pa 'dzin pa dang 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa dman pa dang 'bring gi dngos grub thams cad kyang dbang bskur ba la brten nas 'byung ste/ ye shes thig le las/ dbang bskur gyis ni 'khor los sgyur// the tshom med par byed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i dbang bskur ba len pa la shin tu spro bar mdzod cig de ltar dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon nges par byas nas/ phan yon can gyi dbang de ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni gal te dbang ma thob kyang sngags kyi lam la 'bad par byas na 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ram snyam na/ de lta bu ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin te/ dbang ma thob pas bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don bsgoms kyang dngos grub mi thob cing*/ brgya nang na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub phra mo tsam thob srid kyang phyi mar ngan song du skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur te/

phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med// bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin// gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis// dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa// slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu// zhes so// des na rdo rje theg pa'i lam la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par 'dod pa'i blo gros can dag gis dbang bskur ba len pa la shin tu gus pa byed dgos pa yin no// de ltar thob na phan yon dang ma thob na nyes dmigs yod pa'i dbang de gang gis bskur bar byed pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni rgyud sde rnams nas mang du gsungs kyang mdor bsdu na/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes// cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas// snying rjes slob ma rab 'dzin pa// dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gang la bskur ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul// rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan// sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba// mthun zhing grangs dang ldan par gzung*// zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma nang gshin pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar grangs kha yar ba re gzung ba shis par bshad/ de ltar slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid nges par byas nas/ gang gi tshe bskur ba'i dus ni gza' skar dang sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i yar ngo'am/ de rnams lhag par 'dzom na mar ngo la'ang nyes pa med de/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas nyid// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' skar legs pa 'dzom gyur na// mar ngo la yang nyes pa med// ces so// gang du dbang bskur ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bskyangs shing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa/ khyad par rang ngam bla ma gong mas sa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du byas shing snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa zhig dgos par bshad de/

dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa phyogs chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes so// gang la brten nas bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ mtshon par bya ba nges don don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin pa la bshad de/ kye rdo rje las/ dkyil ni snying po zhes brjod de// byang chub sems ni bde chen po// len par byed pas dkyil 'khor nyid// ces so// de nyid mtshon par byed pa drang don kun rdzob pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub chen so sos bkral ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mang du gsungs kyang*/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas/ ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni// thig la tshon dgye'i rim pas bstan// 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// zhes rdul tshon/ ras bris/ lus dkyil te gsum mam ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang bzhir bshad kyang*/ deng sang gi gang zag phal cher smin byed du rung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gtso che bar bzhed pa yin/ gang zhig bskur ba dbang gi nges tshig ni/ a bhi ṣiñca'am a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sgras gtor zhing blug pa ste sa bon la chu lud kyis btab pa ltar/ dbang bzhi po rim pa bzhin spyi bo dang*/ lce dang*/ dbang gi gnas dang*/ rlung sems la gtor zhing blug pa la brten nas sku bzhi'i myu gu 'byung bas na dbang zhes bya ba yin te/ kye rdo rje las/ gtor dang blug pa zhes bya 'dis// des na dbang zhes brjod par bya// zhes so// 'di yan gyi bshad pa cung zad nyung bar 'dod na lung 'dren gyi tshig rnams dor bas 'grub bo// ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la/ lam la sbyor bar byed pa rgyu'i dbang*/ kun nas goms par byed pa lam gyi dbang*/

mi 'phrogs pa sbyor bar byed pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas gsum du gsungs kyang*/ gang zag gi sgo nas du ma zhig tu 'gyur ba las/ 'dir smin byed kyi cho ga dang mthun par 'chad pa la/ rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub pa'i bla ma brgyud pa las rim par 'ongs pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa la/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul gnyis las/ rdul tshon ltar na nub gnyis pa'am/ ras bris ltar na nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la sa'i lha mo sta gon dang lha dang bum pa lhag gnas te/ lhag gnas dang po gsum kho bos bgyis zin nas/ slob ma lhag gnas la/ lus kyi bya ba gsol ba gdab// sngags kyi theg pa gzung bar gdams// rgyun bshags rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung*// gnas gsum bsrungs mchod so shing dor// khyor chu srung skud ku sha sbyin// chos zab bshad cing rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar bcu gsum las/ lus kyi bya ba khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas/ rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod du gzhug ces 'byung bas/ slob dpon la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul ba mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa stsal du gsol snyam pas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

skye rga na sogs nas bdag ni gzhug tu gsol zhes pas gsol ba btab ste/ de'i don srid pa ni rgya mtsho chen po ltar mtha' dang zad du med pa/ skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa sdug bsngal mi bzad pa chu srin chen po la sogs pa lta bu 'jigs pa du ma dang bcas pa'i gnas de las/ bde ba'i skam sar 'don par mdzad pa'i slob dpon de la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol zhes pa'i tha tshig go /de ltar khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no zhes sngags kyi theg pa gzung bar gdams pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// bu tshur sogs nas blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas zin pa de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par du yang 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin yang 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis dzam+bu'i gling du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/

rtag par zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin no// de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin pas kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob pa'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go /rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos nas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de tshe rabs thogs ma med nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par bgyi snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa thams cad la sems can gyi don gyi phyir mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs snyam pa dang*/ sgo gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bsod nams thams cad sems can gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ gzhan don bla na med pa bsgrub pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed cing de'i spyod pa rnams la'ang tshul bzhin du bslab par bgyi snyam pa 'jug pa sems bskyed pa ste/

don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas zhes pa nas/ da ni yang dag gnas par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar sam+pu ṭa'i rgyun bshags las cung zad kha bskang ba dang bcas te rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so sor thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing*/ thob pa yar 'phel du byed la/ nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin no// gong du gsol gdab kyi tshe/ don du gnyer bya'i gtso bo dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol zhes pa'i dam tshig thob par byed pa la khas blangs dang cho ga'i sgo nas thob par bya ba gnyis yod pa las/ khas blangs kyi sgo nas thob par bya ba la 'dzin rgyu'i dam tshig ngo shes par bya ba'i ched du sdom pa bsgrag pa zhes bya ba 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te zhes pa nas gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni sangs rgyas te rnam snang gi dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa yin te/ rnam snang sangs rgyas kyi sku yin pas yon tan gyi rten byed pa ltar/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pas kyang sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje ste mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje dril bu/ phyag rgya slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa ste mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ dam tshig gsum dang slob dpon yang byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dzin pas so// rin chen te rin 'byung gi dam tshig ni/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug tu gtong ba'am/ dngos su mi nus na 'dun pa dang ma bral bar bya ba ste/

rin 'byung sbyin pa'i ngo bo ser sna rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ sbyin pa yang dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang ser sna'i gnyen po yin pas so// pad+ma ste 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig ni/ phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa' ste theg pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin par dam 'cha' ba ste 'od dpag med shes rab kyi ngo bo gsung rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ chos kyang shes rab kyis 'dzin cing gsung gis ston pas so// las kyi rigs te don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ni sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya ba yin te/ don yod grub pa brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo phrin las kyi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyi sdom pa 'dzin pa dang sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa gnyis ka'ang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rjes su skyong ba yin pas so// de rnams kyis rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bsgrags nas/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig bsgrags pa la tshul khrims gsum spyir bshad pa dang so sor bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis te nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po la 'byung ba'i ltung ba gcig blon po la 'byung ba gcig rgyal blon thun mong du 'byung ba bzhi/ byang sems las dang po pa las 'byung ba brgyad de bcu bzhi po 'di yang bsrung dgos par ston pa lags/ gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum las/ dang po nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi so thar rigs bdun gang rung yin pas rang gi cho ga las thob pa'am/

de ma thob na sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs su yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang na mnyam pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa thob pas na de'i bslab bya rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga po gzhan don du 'gyur na ma gtogs spong dgos par ston pa lags/ dge ba chos sdud ni/ dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste dge ba spyod pa'i grogs skyes bu dam pa dang rnal 'byor pa rnams la brten nas dge ba bcu spyod pa ste/ bcu po der pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len thams cad 'dus pas so// sems can don byed ni/ theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig ste/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i mi mthun phyogs de rnams spangs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don bsgrub dgos par ston pa yin/ de dag mdor bsdus te bsgrag pa ni/ lha dang lha min zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig ste/ gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba'i spyod pa rnams spong ba dang*/ so thar byang sems gnyis su ma zad gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs rgyud sde 'og ma nas bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung dgos par ston pa ste/ rgyud sde gong ma'i sdom pa'i nang du 'og ma'i sdom pa'ang 'du bas so// de ltar bshad pa'i don de dag yid la dran pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs nas mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa khas blangs nas/ sems bskyed pa'i slob ma la bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus gtor zhing hūm̐ zhes pas bsrungs nas/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du mas yar reg ste hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ spyi bor oṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje oṃ gyis mtshan pa rnams lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slar yang snying ga spyi bo mgrin pa rnams su reg ste hūm̐ oṃ āḥzhes brjod pas gsal gdab/ yang yas mar reg ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de cho ga 'dis ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar byas pa yin/ de ltar sems bskyed cing sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du bdug spos shangs la/ dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du/ ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas ljags la/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrungs nas slar bskyed cing mchod de/ mthun rkyen dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa la thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ so shing la oṃ badz+ra dha ra dha ra nas swā hās mngon par bsngags nas bum chus gtor/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtags pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥdzī hwa saṃ war+dha ni swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs pa de khyed rnams phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du byin par mos pa mdzod/ sngags de nyid kyis byin/ so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te so drud pa bzhin byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/

dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te/ cang mi gsung ba'am/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ zhes gsung zhing thal mo kha phye ste so shing gi rwa bar tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus su ltos pa med par dor cig ces spyi ltar dor du bcug de ltar dor ba'i rtse mo bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog 'grub/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub phran tsheg re 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ so shing gis so dang kha la sogs pa lus gtso che ba'i dri ma sbyong ba bzhin du bum dbang gis kyang gtso bor lus kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa yin no// rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+māḥsar+b+ba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sar+b+ba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lan gsum gsum byin/ de ni gsang dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ khyor chus ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba bzhin/ gsang dbang gis kyang ngag gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa yin no// rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ bzla zhing skud pa la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa gong bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang srung skud thal mo'i bar bzung nas/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig pa'i srad bu la thim zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzla zhing slob ma rnams skad cig gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpung pa g.yon par nyis bskor du bcings/ bum chus gtor zhing gur gyi yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o// de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi snod rung byed pa'i thabs te/ srung skud 'dogs pa shes rab ye shes kyi sbyang gzhi khams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir yin pa bzhin/ shes rab ye shes kyang khams bdud rtsi la bskur ba yin no// rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i phon che chung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces dang dhīḥbazlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ ku sha chung ba sngas kyi don du phyag g.yas dang*/ che ba stan gyi don du g.yon du byin/ de'i don ku sha 'di ni 'dag byed kyi rdzas bla na med pa yin pa ltar/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyis kyang mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'dag par byed pas ku sha sbyin pa dbang bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro yin zhing*/ sngon dus bcom ldan 'das kyis ku sha ma 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin du rjes su slob pa rnams kyang ku sha'i stan la nyal te/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa yin no// phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir chos zab mo bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis zhes pa nas/ tshul la gnas na thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i snod du gyur pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed kyis/

rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste/ de'i rigs su skye bzhin par 'gyur bas na/ theg chen gyi lam mchog tu gyur pa 'di la brten nas myur du 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyis mchod pa'i gnas nyid du 'gyur la/ de lta bu'i go 'phang de'ang rang gi ngo bo bden gnyis zung 'jug yin zhing rtogs byed kyi thabs kyang bden pa gnyis kyis gsal bar byas pa yin te/ yod pa dang med pa la sogs pa'i mtha' gnyis las 'das pa/ dpe nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med pa'i chos kyi dbyings ni zab mo ste/ rtog pa thams cad kyis mi rtogs shing*/ skye 'gags dang gnas pa med pas spros pa kun dang bral ba ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin la/ spros bral de'i ngang nas spros pa yod par spros pa ste/ rten 'brel gyi snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba rnams brtags pa'i las dang bya ba la sogs pa'i rtogs pa dang bral ba ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa ste/ de ltar bden pa gnyis zung 'jug tu ston pa'i theg pa mchog gi tshul 'di la gnas na thob par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don yin/ de ltar spro ba bskyed nas/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba bya ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun nga la drang po smros// zhes bshad pas rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal zhig bcas te slob dpon gyis byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du btings/ gos dri ma med pa gyon/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal te/ sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thag ring du byas/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas sang nyin yi dam gyi lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin dang ldan par nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur te/

de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong ba ni// yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin// mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong*// de la mchod par rtsom pa dang*// dge slong dag las chos nyan tam// yang na mi nyan na yang rung*// chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang*// de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod// ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma las chos nyan pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang po zhon pa/ nyi phug tu nyi ma lde ba/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa/ 'bru'am bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gter rnyed pa/ skye bo mang pos bdag la 'dud bstod byed pa/ skye bo mang po la bdag nyid kyis chos bshad pa/ pha ma dang bla ma dang mdza' bshes dang 'phrad pa/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa la sogs pa rmi na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te na ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon te kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ g.yang sa dang gcong rong du zhugs pa/ ri dang shing las lhung ba/ khyi dang khwa dang srin pos zos pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ skra bregs pa/ lus til mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dmar pos thod bcings pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas/

gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med pa/ don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsrungs te sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin lung blangs te nyams su len pa dang zhi ba'i sreg blugs bya ba la sogs pas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin/ de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni sang nyin 'byung ba lags/ zhes brjod do// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang shin tu zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa'ang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag par re byed dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan don dam par sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na'ang gnas skabs glo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi 'khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin te/

sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams kyi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med pas sogs nas 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag pa'i ched du/ ji skad du/ rje ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ spang bya sdig pa'i phyogs las ring 'phags shing*// chos sku mkha' ltar mi rtog mkha' mnyam 'gro// gzugs sku rdzu 'phrul bkod pa mkhar 'gro zhing*// rdo rje dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab dang*// gur ni phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes che// zhes gsungs pa ltar dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pas srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtog pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' rten dang bcas pa blangs la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngon du song bas/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ slob dpon du dbang thob par bya ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro bdag lhar bskyed// mchod pa byin rlabs dkyil 'khor sgrub// mchod pa 'bul dang bdud rtsi myong*// phyogs skyong gtor 'bul lhag chad bskang*// zhes pa ltar brgyad kyi sgo nas bsgrub cing mchod nas/ gnyis pa slob dpon du dbang thob par bya ba la'ang slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis len pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs shing bden pa bsgrags pa/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba dang bcas pa rnams dgos te/

de rnams sngon du grub par byas pa yin/ gsum pa khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis su yod pa las/ 'jug pa la/ maṇ+ḍal phul dang gsol gdab gnyis// 'dod pa dri lan rgyun bshags bya// rigs lnga'i sdom gzung gos dag byin// 'khyil pas bsangs nas phreng ba gtad// sbyang ba dris lan nang du gzhug /lus dbul ba dang dam tshig sbyin// dam gzhag maṇ+ḍal gsol ba gdab// ye shes dbab brtan kha dog dri// me tog dor bcing gdong g.yogs dbye// dkyil 'khor bltar bskul lha ngo bstan// spro ba bskyed cing dam tshig brjod// ces pa ltar nyer lnga yod pa sde tshan so sor dpyad na phyi rol du bya ba/ nang du gzhug pa/ nang du bya ba'i cho ga ste gsum gyi/ dang por slob dpon la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste zhes sogs nas slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ zhes pas slob dpon la gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rnams dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba zhu ba ni/ las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba cung zad bteg slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rnam dag slob ma 'di rnams sogs nas 'tshal// zhes pa'i don ni/ thun mong gi sbyang bas rgyud rnam par dag pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin 'dzin cing*/ gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams nod par 'tshal na/

de bzhin du gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i don yin/ de nas khyed rnams gsang ba'i dam tshig 'dzin pa la spro ba'am zhes 'dri ba ni/ gsang ba chen po'i sogs nas 'dod dam/ zhes pa'i don ni/ gsang ba chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rigs te/ rgyud rnam par dag pa gsang ba'i ngo bo dam tshig dang sdom pa yongs su 'dzin par bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam zhes dris pa la/ khyed rnams kyis kyang ji ltar dris pa de ltar 'dzin par spro'o// zhes lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi mthar/ sems dpa' chen po bdag 'tshal lo// zhes lan btab nas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma sogs sta gon ltar las tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum brjod/ bdag gis thog ma med dus zhes pa nas gnas par bgyi/ zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar nas mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pas dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus par bzung bar khas blangs nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas te smad g.yogs gos dmar po re thogs nas khyed rnams la byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs kyis sbyin/ sngon chad mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong bcing bar mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ bī ra sogs kyis bcings/ slob dpon gyis bsrung ba'i ched du oṃ badz+ra sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing las bum gyi chus gtor nas bsrung ba byas par mos pa mdzod/

khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas/ phyag rten gyi slad du me tog rigs lnga brgyus pa'i phreng ba re'ang byin par mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ sogs kyis sbyin/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams yod par gsal btab/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs par mos te/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ nang du gzhug pa la/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// de ltar rigs nges par byas nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi lag pa bzung ste dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos pa mdzad nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ki li ki li sogs nas yuṃ swā hā/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos par bya ba de rnams ni phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang du bya ba'i cho ga la gsum gyi thog mar lus dbul ba'i slad du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gsal btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la gus pas lus dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs nas mi/ de ltar lus phul nas/ ye shes dbab pa dang 'brel ba la dam tshig spyir sbyin pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po re gsal lam gyis yod par mos nas/

de nyid brtan pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag cing dril bu 'khrol ba dang bcas te/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya a haṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas nas/ dam la bzhag pa bzhi las dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste deng khyod nas ta re/ zhes dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod sogs nas gshegs zhes dang*/ phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ sngon du bsgrubs pa'i dam tshig gi chu oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bsngags la byin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi nas oṃ āḥswā hā zhes dang*/ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng phyin chad khyod nas ta re/ zhes pa de rnams dam la bzhag pa yin/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams lus tsog pu gang la'ang ma snyes par me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te sems gzhan du ma yengs par mdzod cig spro na/ 'dir ye shes dbab pa zhes pa'i don ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ brdzun min bden min de bzhin du// thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar// 'dod pa rnal 'byor pas shes kyis// 'di lta ste/ gtsub shing dang gtsub rten dang*/ skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba las glo bur du me 'byung ngo*// me de gtsub shing la yang ma yin/ gtsub rten la'ang ma yin/ skyes bu'i lag pa dag la yang ma yin te/ rnam pa thams cad du yongs su btsal na gcig na'ang yod pa ma yin pas/ me de bden pa'ang ma yin/ rdzun pa yang ma yin te/ de ltar chos thams cad rnal 'byor pas yid la gyis shig ces pa ltar rang la 'byung rung gi ye shes pa rang rgyud la grub zin pa ma yin zhing*/

gzhan rgyud la grub zin gyi ye shes pa bdag la 'pho ba ma yin yang*/ gzhan rgyud la grub zin gyi ye shes pa lha la sogs pa'i rnam pa can du sngags dang rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'bebs pa'i cho ga byas pa la brten nas rang rgyud la 'byung rung gi ye shes pa mngon du gyur pa la ye shes phebs pa'i tha snyad byed pa lags pa de'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ 'di bar ma brjod kyang rung ngo*// chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas te/ de'i ngang nas khyed rang rnams he ru kar gsal ba langs nas yod pa'i snying gar laṃ las sogs nas rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ ljang gu drag cing bzod par dka' ba ste lus la 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams bkod de/ slob dpon la dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos te sum mdo'i me sbar zhes pa nas yed yed yod par gyur/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa dang po'i rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas rgya mtsho la char babs pa ltar thim par mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ a dzhaiṃ zhes dang*/ oṃ lo le sogs dang*/ ā we sha ya sogs nas hūm̐ āḥhaḥdzhaiṃ/ zhes rol mo dang 'bebs pa'i rdzas kyi dud pa dang bcas pas dbab bo// de la ye shes babs pa'i rtags ni sku babs pas ni 'phar g.yo la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// gsung babs pas ni sngags smra bar 'gyur ro// thugs babs pas ni yongs su shes pa skye'o// de ltar ye shes babs pa de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/

oṃ tiṣ+ṭha nas ho swā hā/ zhes brjod la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtod par mdzod cig dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la thog mar dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i ched du khyed rnams mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin/ ye shes dbab pa'i dmigs pa gtad la/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung du dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas mgo dgu bar byas te bltas pas/ mig lam du kha dog gang mthong ba cig nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang zhes dris la/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po'am nag po la mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am sna tshogs sam khra bor mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtags nas/ me tog 'bul ba ni 'di na bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ ngo bo la bzang ngan gyi khyad par med mod/ 'on kyang rang gis las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pa'i blos/ oṃ pra tī sogs gsung zhing 'bul ba'i tshul mdzod cig ces bsgos la phul te gang du ltung ba'am nye ba de'i rigs su nges par byas/ me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs nas slob ma'i spyi bor bcings te/ stobs po chen po nas gzung bar byos zhes brjod/ khyed rnams kyi mig gnyis su oṃ yig rab tu 'bar ba re sgoms shig oṃ he ru ka nas swā hā/ zhes mig ras bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba 'di la gsan pas khyab pa gda' ste/ dkyil 'khor bzang po nas byin gyis brlab ces pas blta bar bskul nas/ gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'di na dpal mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs te/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i rwa ba gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/

dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad sogs nas brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung gi nang du tshud pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad pa ye shes kyi snang ba las grub cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor/ shar du phan pa'i dkyil 'khor/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ nub tu pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor/ byang du rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor te/ de rnams kyi dbus su pad+ma dkar dmar 'dab ma brgyad pa re re'i lte bar bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i snying gar/ shar du zla ba/ dbus dang phyogs gzhan gsum du nyi ma'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad po rnams dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir zla ba dang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni phyi'i shar sgor lcags kyu ma/ lho sgor zhags pa ma/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgor dril bu ma/ de rnams kyi nang gi shar du phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du skam pa ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu dol zlum ma/ byang du lcags kyu ma/ byang shar du me tog ma/ shar lhor bdug pa ma/ lho nub tu mar me ma/ nub byang du byug pa ma ste brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ rtag pa sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du nyi lag ma/ lhor mar me ma/ nub tu rin chen skar mda' ma/ byang du glog lag ma/ byang shar du sgeg mo/ shar lhor bzhad pa mo/ lho nub tu glu ma/ nub byang du gar ma ste brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rin chen rgyal po gser btso ma lta bu yum rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

nub tu pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du pad+ma ma/ lhor chos 'byung ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du 'khyud ma/ byang shar du gling bu ma/ shar lhor pi waṃ ma/ lho nub tu rnga zlum ma/ nub byang du rdza rnga ma ste brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rta mgrin pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ byang du rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du sgo lcags ma/ lhor lde kyog ma/ nub tu sgo glegs ma/ byang du gos 'dzin ma/ byang shar du spyan ma/ shar lhor mā ma kī/ lho nub tu gos dkar mo/ nub byang du sgrol ma ste brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rta mchog sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang ba yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dbus su rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu be tā lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha wa rī/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo ste brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog dbang po sngon po lta bu yum mā ma kī dang mnyam par sbyor ba ste zhes sku mdog sogs rags pa tsam brjod nas bstan la/ de ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mthong ngo snyam pa'i dga' ba'i blos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ rdo rje'i nas bskur zhes dang*/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig ma lus pa gzung bar mos pa byas la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya ho ho ho zhes pa rnams lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga yin/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la gnyis las/ dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab// lhar bskyed byur bsal shis par brjod// chu dang cod paṇa rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs sbyin// gsang sngags bzlas pa'i lung bya'o// zhes pa ltar las/

thog mar rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal sogs nas thob par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab ste/ sngon 'gro byur bsal ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor sogs nas dbur brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ de'i steng du bla re zhes pa nas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod/ mdun du sbyang chas rnams ci 'byor pa bsham/ til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis bya/ sbyang ba dngos la/ thog mar de nyid la chu bzhi'i sbyang ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ nī ri sogs nas ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ zhes pas sbyangs te/ khyed rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs nas mdun gyi til la thim/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas he ru ka zhig bye ba las kye rdo rje dang tha mi dad par gyur nas khyed rnams kyi sdig sgrib kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yungs kar de g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsreg g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba sogs nas chus kyang sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ nas phaṭa/ byur dang sogs nas gyur cig ces pas byur bsal nas/ bkra shis kyi cho ga la khyed rang rnams la mchod pa lngas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa thogs nas g.yas su yo ba dang bcas nas bkra shis kyi cho ga byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis brjod pa la/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la 'di ltar nges par bya ste sogs spyi bshad kye rdo rje'i skabs ltar brjod la phyag len phal cher 'di la mdzad pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon gyis swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gsum ga'ang rdo rje can sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba sogs nas bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī nas ku ru hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥslob dpon la thim/ de'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi sogs 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ a

'di slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus su mi bskyod pa la bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka la dbang bskur dgos pas sngags kyi gsol gdab 'di ltar rung mod/ rin 'byung man chad dang bdag 'jug gi skabs su/ dbang rdzas kyi dbang thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes brjod na legs so// bhi ṣīñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes pas gsol ba btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing slob dpon dang dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rgyud la sogs nas slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal nyid du gnas nas/ dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje can yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las sogs nas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas dbang bskur cig ces gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig tu mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin can gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te khyed rang rnams mi bskyod par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod nas/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las sogs nas bzhag pa yin no// de'ang mi bskyod pa dang chu dbang sbyar ba ni/ mi bskyod pa thugs kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ rgyud las kyang*/ gang phyir byang sems gsher ba nyid// gsher ba chu yi khams su brjod// chu ni mi bskyod gzugs kyi phyir// zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa// zhes bde ba'i rten byang sems gsher ba'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa yin par gsungs shing*/

mi bskyod pa ni rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo yin pa ltar/ bum pa'i chu yang dbang rdzas kyi gtso bo yin la/ sbyang gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po las nyon gyi bag chags bsgo ba'i rten yin pa ltar ram/ yang na 'phags pa lhas/ chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro ste// yid gtso yid kyi 'gros can yin// zhes pa ltar/ sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo 'khor bar skye ba len pa po rnam shes yin pas de sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes la sbyar ba'ang yod la/ yang sbyangs 'bras me long ye shes kyang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste// ye shes gsum ni de la brten// zhes ye shes gzhan gyi rten byed par gsungs shing*/ sbyang bya zhe sdang skyes na kha dog gnag pa ltar/ sbyong byed mi bskyod pa'ang sku mdog nag por 'byung ba yin no// 'og ma rnams la slob dpon lhar bskyed pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs pa dor nas lha dang dbang rdzas go bsgyur ba ma gtogs cho ga'i 'gros 'di nyid sbyar bar bya ba yin pas/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ khyed rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te sogs nas bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i aṃ las sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ gau rī nas hoḥkhyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ de'i mig tu nas thugs rdo rje ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sogs nas stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor cod paṇa bcings pas rgyud la bde chen gyi sogs nas dbang rdzas cod paṇa du gyur/ khyed rang rnams la yan lag bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang*/

slob dpon lhan cig pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin can gyi cod paṇa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs nas khyed rnams rin chen 'byung ldan du gsal ba'i spyi bor bcings nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang zhes sogs nas māṃ/ zhes pas khyed rang rnams la cod paṇa bcings te dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi sogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las sogs nas mnyam nyid ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// de'ang rin 'byung dang cod paṇa gyi dbang sbyar ba ni/ rin 'byung sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi ngo bo gdul bya'i bsam pa 'gengs par byed pa yin la/ zag med kyi yon tan thams cad ye shes lngar 'dus pa ltar/ ye shes lnga gzugs rnam du shar ba'i gzugs sku thams cad kyang rigs lngar 'dus la/ de rnams mtshon byed rin po che'i cod paṇa gyis kyang gdul bya'i bsam pa 'gengs par mtshon zhing sbyang gzhi tshor phung gis tshor ba bde sdug myong bas yul la blang dor byed pa'i gnyen po/ sbyangs 'bras mnyam nyid ye shes kyis 'khor ba mi gtong zhing myang 'das la mi gnas la/ sbyang bya nga rgyal dang ser sna longs spyod la brten nas 'byung zhing longs spyod kyi gtso bo rin po che 'od gsal ba ltar rin 'byung sku mdog ser po 'byung ba yin no// 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs dang khyed rang rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te sogs nas dbang rdzas kyi lha'i phyag g.yas su rdo rje sbyin pas rgyud la bde chen zhes sogs nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos kyi bar lha dang dbang rdzas kyi khyad ma gtogs 'dra bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas su byin nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/

sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis ni sogs nas wa ra ta ka hūm̐/ zhes pas khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas su rdo rje byin pas rgyud la bde chen gyi sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga la sogs nas sor rtog ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// de'ang 'od dpag med dang rdo rje'i dbang sbyor ba ni/ 'od dpag med sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ rdo rje rtse dgu pas kyang bshad bya'i chos gsung rab yan lag dgu mtshon zhing*/ rtse dgu ni/ gur las/ rdo rje chen po rtse dgu pa// zhes pa'i don rdo rje rtse lnga'i steng 'og gi rwa bzhi bzhi dang dbus rwa thal byung du yod pa la gur 'grel las bshad cing*/ gsung rab yan lag dgu'i tha snyad kyang bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las 'byung ngo*// sbyang gzhi 'du shes kyis yul la mtshan mar bzung nas spu ris so sor 'byed pa ltar/ sbyangs 'bras so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis kyang chos can thams cad ma 'dres par so sor mkhyen la/ sbyang bya 'dod chags skyes na kha dog dmar ba ltar/ 'od dpag med kyang sku mdog dmar por 'byung ba yin no// don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs dang khyed rnams kyi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te sogs nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos kyi bar gong gis 'gre/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon lhan cig pas don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dril bu gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs nas khyed rang rnams don yod grub par gsal ba'i phyag g.yon du byin nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti zhes pas khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yon du dril bu sbyin pas bde chen gyi sogs nas bya grub ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// de'ang don grub dang dril bu'i dbang sbyar ba ni/

don grub sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi ngo bo yin pas/ phrin las kyi gtso bo gdul bya chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba la sbyor bar mdzad pa ltar/ dril bu'i sgras kyang skye 'gags dang bral ba'i don ston zhing khog pa stong pa dang shes phyin gyi zhal gyis chos nyid rang bzhin gyis stong par rtogs pa mtshon zhing*/ sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyis yul 'dus byas nas rang don sgrub pa'i gnyen por sbyangs 'bras bya drug ye shes kyis sems can gyi don sgrub la/ sbyang bya phrag dog nyon mongs pa kun ldan yin pa ltar/ don grub kyang kha dog kun ldan ljang gur 'byung ba yin no// rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs nas khyed rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī sogs nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ de'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ 'dir dbang rdzas lhar sgrub pa med pas khyed rnams la yan lag bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rnam snang gi rang bzhin can gyi ming gdan gsum tshang ba re me tog gang la phog pa'i lha las gras te btags par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs nas a bhi ṣe ka ta kye zhes dri/ gsang mtshan med na gsar du btags te/ de yang skyes pa la/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rol pa'i rdo rje a la la rdo rje// shin tu dga' ba'i myu gu'i rdo rje dang*// zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rnam snang chen po'i rdo rje kye rdo rje// zhes sogs dang*/ bud med la/ rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje mtshon cha ma// rdo rje bdag med e ma ho bde ma// rdo rje sgeg ma la sogs gang rigs gdags// de ltar ming btags pas rgyud la bde chen gyi sogs nas me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// de'ang rnam snang dang ming dbang sbyar ba ni/

rnam snang sangs rgyas kyi sku yin pas gdul byas mtshon sla zhing skus yon tan gyi rten byed pa ltar/ ming gis kyang rigs mtshon sla zhing lung ston pa la sogs pa'i rten byed de/ mnyam sbyor las/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// de bzhin gshegs par de lung bstan// zhes 'byung ba lags shing*/ sbyang gzhi gzugs phung ni shes pa la der snang ba tsam las don gzhan du med pa ltar/ sbyangs 'bras chos dbyings ye shes kyang*/ ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pas// chos kyi dbyings la ye shes su bshad// ces pa ltar ye shes las don gzhan pa'i dbyings ma grub cing*/ skabs la lar/ me long ye shes nga yir med// ces pa'i tshul gyis me long ye shes dang yang sbyor bar yod la/ sbyang bya gti mug can gang du'ang bsgyur du btub pa ltar/ rnam snang sku mdog dkar por 'byung ba yin no// dbang de rnams kyi don ni/ dngos kun sogs nas blta bar gyis zhes gsungs te/ de yang dngos po ste chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba ni gtso bo ste rang gi lhag pa'i lha yin la/ lha de'ang glo bur du byas pa ma yin gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i phyir gdod ma nas lhar rnam par dag cing glo bur gyi dri ma rnams cho ga 'dis sel bar byed pas na da phyin chad de dag la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su blta bar gyis shig ces bya ba'i tha tshig go /de dag gis ni ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga/ rig pa ye shes lngar sgyur bar byed pas rig pa'i dbang ngam/ rig ma spyan la sogs pa'i thabs rig pa yab lnga'i las yin pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ba yin/ de rnams kyis chos can gyi snang ba thams cad lhar byin gyis brlabs nas/ de dag gi chos nyid drug pa rdo rje sems dpar ngo sprad de sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang khyed rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥnas hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ de'i mig tu nas thugs rdo rje ma/ slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs dang*/ dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de ltar rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas par brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du sbyin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid sogs nas hi hi hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i rdo rje de gsor te snying gar bzung nas/ deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la zhugs par gyis shig de ltar na rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas bya spyod kyi chu cod paṇa rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang ste lnga las thob byed kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud 'chad pa dang nyan pa la dbang ba'i dbang thob/ de'i steng du tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum brtul nas rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang thob pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi slob ma'i dbang las thob byed kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i bla med kyi rdo rje slob ma'i dbang thob pas rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang bar byas shing*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'chad pa la mi dbang yang nyan pa la dbang ba dang rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i las tshogs dang dngos grub kyi sgrub thabs dang dran pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang du rung ba yin no// de bas na khyed rnams me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i bsgom bzlas la brtson par gyis shig

des sangs rgyas thams cad bzlas pas mnyes par 'gyur bas khyed rnams kyis dman pa dang 'bring gi dngos grub gang 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bsgo/ de ltar nges par byas nas/ bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ āṃ khaṃ rnams kyi mthar sngags rnams kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ āṃ khaṃ rnams yod par gsal btab/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag pos gsang sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos nas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ dha ra sogs gtso bo lnga'i sngags lan gsum gyis rjes zlos byed du gzhug de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis me tog dor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis me tog spyi bor bzhag nas sngags kyi dngos grub stsal zhing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// de ltar thun mong gi dbang drug gis khyed rnams kyi rags pa phung khams skye mched de bzhin nyid dang bcas pa lhar byin gyis brlabs/ phra ba dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhir byin gyis rlob par byed pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi'i dang po phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang la bzhi ste/

bzhi char la/ sngon 'gro yon dbul gsol ba gdab// dngos gzhi slob dpon dbang bskur dang*// mjug tu mtha' rten so sor sbyin// zhes pa ltar las dang po phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs nas bdag la stsol/ slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag /de med na khyed rnams gong du bshad pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng du lhar bskyed ma thag pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te/ de rnams kyis mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa dang*/ bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ slob dpon dang lhan cig pas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang*/ slar yang rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dngos gzhi'i tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams brjod cing dbang rdzas byin te dbang bskur/ de nas dam tshig gsum rim gyis sbyin dgos pa las/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje bshad ma thag pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin can de khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas su byin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sogs nas hi hūm̐/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de gsor te snying gar 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzung nas rdo rje'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod pa zhu/ thog mtha' med sogs nas bdag po'i bdag ces gsungs te de'i don ni/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ khyed rnams kyi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/

dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du oṃ swa bhā wa nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ de ltar dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yon du byin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sogs nas rgyal bar bzhed// ces pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i dril bu de nyid dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung ste dril bu'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod par zhu/ srid pa sogs nas byed pa yin// zhes gsungs te de'i don ni dril bu 'di chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba skye 'gags gnas gsum gyis stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ khyed rnams kyi ngag srid thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'i slad du khyed rnams la rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re byin par mos pa mdzod/ shes rab bcu drug sogs nas dbang du 'dod// ces dang*/ rjes su gnang ba mdor bsdus pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje che dang sogs nas bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes brjod/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi slad du khyed rang rnams rdo rje 'chang chen po sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī sogs nas khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i mig tu sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par brjod pa ni/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i phyag rgyas bzung ste shes rab ma lo grangs bcu drug lon pa lta bu de dang nu ma la sogs pa phan tshun reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba la brten nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad khyab par gyur pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

srid pa'i sogs nas brtan phyir ro// zhes gsungs te de'i don ni/ tha mal pa'i bde ba ni/ ma dag pa'o// srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig thams cad la mchod pa gyis shig 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da'o// de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'og tu mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa ma byung gi bar du phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin de las ma g.yos par mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ nam mkhar gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa/ glu dang rol mo dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po nas sbyin par bya/ bcom ldan rdo rje can gyi chus sogs chu dbang rgyas par bskur la/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon lhan cig pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par byas pa mos shig /oṃ su pra sogs nas swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par byas te/ de nyid la mnga' dbul gyi slad du/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa rgyas pas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas hūm̐/ de ltar khyed la rdo rje 'chang sogs nas 'khor lo yin gyi/ de las logs su dkyil 'khor btsal du med de/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni

'di rnams la 'gyur khyad cung zad mi 'dra ba yod pa rnams gzhan gyi shan ma shor ba byed dgos/ gang bshad pa sogs nas/ do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod// de ltar rang sems de nyid ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis phung khams skye mched sna tshogs su snang yang de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i ngo bor dag pa ni/ rgyal ba mgon po phan pa sogs nas/ bgegs ni mthar byed ces byar bshad// ces pas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i rnam dag bstan nas/ rnam dag rtogs pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba rnams rim pa bzhin bsgrub dgos pa las/ thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya rnams mdzad par zhu/ deng nas brtsams te sogs nas lus can rnams la bsgos/ gāḥ deng phyin chad lus kyi sgo nas sgeg pa dang*/ ngag gi sgo nas glu len pa la sogs pa spyod pa ci byed pa thams cad mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan ma yin par lha mchod pa'i bsam pas zin par gyis shig sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/ mig thur ram rdo rje la oṃ dha ra sogs nas swā hā zhes pa'i rtsa sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin gyi mig thur ram/ yang na rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer bskyed pas khyed rnams kyi mig gi thad kar byugs pas ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar mig mkhan nas hrīḥpraṃ zhes pas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas nas/ chos can gyi snang ba thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar nges pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du a las skyes pa'i me long bstan te/ chos rnams sogs nas sras su skye zhes pas me long dang po'i rjes gnang byin nas/ de ltar kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las du mar snang yang dril bu'i sgra khog pa dang lce dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba gsum gang las byung dpyad na mi rnyed pas rang bzhin gyis stong pa ltar chos nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can du shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du dbyangs tha ma ste aḥtsheg drag can las skyes pa'i dril bu byin te/

thams cad nam mkha'i sogs nas mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ zhes pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang bral na nyan rang gi sar ltung bar 'gyur bas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas byos shig ces pas hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu byin te/ thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkangs nas phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis te drug tu 'phangs pas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom par mos la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o zhes gsungs shig gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab de'ang thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab ltar don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa tsam ma yin gyi/ dbang gi ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu myong yang rang bzhin med pa rang gi snying la zhugs pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du me long rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ ā badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas shes par gyis shig ces pa rnams ni sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang yin no// chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ zhes pas zhabs kyi 'og tu 'khor lo byin te sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'dren lugs ji ltar byed na badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas phyag g.yas su dung byin te/ dung bus la sems can 'khor du sdus shig ces pa'i don yin/ tshul ji ltar na badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas phyag g.yon par dril bu byin te chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na a zhes pas lag ngar gyi steng du rgyud kyi glegs bam byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don yin pas/ de ltar nges pa'i sgo nas 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/

dung 'bud pa dang*/ dril bu 'khrol ba dang*/ glegs bam klog pa'i tshul mdzod cig deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa sogs nas srung bar mdzod ces spyir btang chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang byin nas/ chos bshad pa de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'brel pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos ston dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ ji ltar ji lta sogs nas nye bar sbyor zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni thabs kyi bye brag ji lta bu'i tshul ji ltar 'dul bar 'gyur ba legs par rtogs nas/ thabs de lta bu dang tshul de ltar sems can gyi don bya dgos pas/ thabs gtsang ba ni dag pa ste dug lnga gang dang gang 'brel ba de dang rjes su mthun par bstan nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu la sbyor bar gyis shig ces pa'i don yin pas/ khyed rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du rim par 'phos nas phyag rgya rnams kyi lad mo mdzod/ 'jig rten kun la sogs nas da lta gyis// zhes pa rnams chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba yin/ de ltar phyi dbyibs kyi sogs kyis rtogs bskyed bya'o// des bum dbang 'khor du bcas pa song nas/ gsang ba'i dbang zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya zhig kyang slob dpon la phul bar mos nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs dang bcom ldan zhi ba sogs nas bdag la skyobs zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching ba zhu/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rnam par snang mdzad dang spyan ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba slob dpon rang nyid kyi mtheb srin gyis blangs te khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs nas dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ 'di ni de nyid bla na med sogs nas yang dag myang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i don dran bzhin pas bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te myang bar zhu/ de ltar myang bas mgrin pa na gzhir gnas pa'i ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge byang chub sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems gdan gsum tshang ba de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pas snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags pa rnams 'gags nas stong pa dang shin tu stong pa dang stong pa chen po'i nyams skyes spyod bsdus las 'byung ba'i don shes rab snang ba'i 'khor du byung ba'i 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum/ thabs snang ba mched pa'i 'khor du byung ba'i zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu/ snang ba thob pa'i ye shes nyer thob kyi 'khor du byung ba'i gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun te brgyad cu'o// te snang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin stong pa gsum ro gcig tu gyur pa gsal zhing yang la mi rtog par byung gi ye shes stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol ba zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul sku rab tu byung ba'i rnam pas ston par srid pas/ skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur nas lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags bag phab pa'i rna ba ltar 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ khyed rnams rang rang gi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mos pa mdzod/
